استوقيت (form X)
# اِسْتَوْقَيْتُ (istawqaytu) /is.taw.qaj.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَوْقَى (istawqā)
# اِسْتَوْقَيْتَ (istawqayta) /is.taw.qaj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَوْقَى (istawqā)
# اِسْتَوْقَيْتِ (istawqayti) /is.taw.qaj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَوْقَى (istawqā)
# اُسْتُوقِيتُ (ustūqītu) /us.tuː.qiː.tu/: f
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
